recommendation_summary: The reply says to skip the central log and Docker and set up one hosted dead-man's-switch heartbeat check (such as Healthchecks.io), pinged by `nightly-sync`, that alerts the user if no successful run is seen by about 04:30.
note: The reply recommends only the single hosted heartbeat alert and rejects the Synology, Docker and central-log setup, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
